responsibility: This file implements the generic graph algorithms used to enumerate prime paths for GCC path-coverage support. Operating on `graphds` graphs rather than directly on GIMPLE CFGs, it builds and manipulates tries of path fragments, handles SCC-aware decomposition and recombination of cyclic and acyclic components, enforces a heuristic complexity limit to avoid path explosion, and returns the resulting `vec<vec<int>>` prime paths. It also contains checking-build selftests for the trie structures and path-construction logic. Its responsibility is the reusable prime-path discovery engine, separate from any instrumentation of GCC IR.
